features.method: Coordinate taken directly from the HAWC design/operation paper's own stated site latitude and longitude (18.99 N, 97.31 W), fetched via a text-extraction proxy (r.jina.ai) after WebFetch could not parse the paper's PDF binary directly. accuracy_m 600 covers the two-decimal-degree rounding (+-0.005 degrees ~ 550 m at this latitude). This is a tighter, more directly relevant coordinate than the site record's current one (a Nominatim geocode of the Sierra Negra peak, precision_m 3000) -- reported as a site coordinate correction candidate in the worklog. The array's own footprint (300 tanks, ~20,000-22,500 m2, 'placed in joint pairs of rows' on a platform levelled from an 8% to a 1% slope) has no stated overall outline shape (circular/hexagonal/irregular) in the fetched text, so it is not drawn as a polygon this session.
